name: Project Willow
summary: Willow introduces 105 superconducting transmons with unprecedented gate fidelities (>99.9%), demonstrating real-time fault-tolerant surface code error correction below the physical threshold. Willow cuts logical error rates in half as code distance increases from 3 to 5 to 7.

name: Project AlphaFold
tagline: AI for Biomolecular Interaction & Structure Prediction
summary: AlphaFold 3 predicts the structures and interactions of all life's molecules: proteins, nucleic acids, ligands, and post-translational modifications. Over 2 million researchers across 190 countries have utilized the AlphaFold database to accelerate biological discovery.

name: Project GraphCast
summary: GraphCast delivers 10-day global atmospheric forecasts at 0.25-degree resolution in under a minute, predicting cyclone tracks, atmospheric rivers, and extreme heat waves with higher accuracy than top numerical weather prediction supercomputers.

name: Project Med-Gemini
tagline: Specialized Multimodal Foundation Models for Medicine
summary: Med-Gemini equips foundational multimodal architectures with medical web search grounding, specialized radiology fine-tuning, and long-context clinical record synthesis, surpassing human physician benchmarks on USMLE MedQA.

name: Project Earth AI & FloodHub
tagline: Global Crisis Resilience & Early Warning Systems
summary: Combining satellite imagery, hydrological sensor telemetry, and physics-informed neural networks to provide riverine flood forecasts up to 7 days in advance across 80+ countries covering 460M people, alongside real-time wildfire tracking.

name: Deep Review
tagline: AI-Powered Technical Synthesis & Peer Review Assistant
summary: An intelligent technical synthesis tool that assists researchers in dissecting complex academic papers, identifying methodology assumptions, comparing experimental baselines, and verifying mathematical derivations.
